record.question: When should a new consent form be completed for a repeat radiology procedure?
options: When the patient expresses any confusion about the procedure.
If any new or changed risks are identified.
Never, a single signed form is valid for all future procedures.
record.explanation: Answer B: If any new or changed risks are identified.. A new consent discussion/form is needed if material risks or the procedure change; blanket consent is not valid for every future procedure. Reference: https://aerb.gov.in/english/radiation-protection-principle; https://aerb.gov.in/images/PDF/DiagnosticRadiology/REGULATORY-REQUIREMENTS-FOR-DIAGNOSTIC-RADIOLOGY-PRACTICE.pdf; https://nucleus.iaea.org/sites/nss-oui/Published%20Chunks/m_60b8e698-4f59-4c24-809a-dfb819ac5050/c_92a88144-44da-418c-a878-9c778590e687__9_0.Html. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
